compiled_state.title: [reconciler/outbound_differ]: residual in-window field re-emitter — ~4 keys update every pass (not 404, not comment)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
After fixing the two main convergence bugs (1e08 stale-binding-404 re-emitter and 6afc comment-sync failure), live verification on main (v1.17.137) shows the reconciler converged 897->16->11->4 mutations but NOT to 0. A residual cluster of in-window bound keys emits an outbound 'update' every pass.

## Evidence
- Runs 27040420321 (11 updates) then 27040540770 (4 updates) on main@32a5985802.
- Persisting keys across BOTH post-fix passes: DIG-5347, DIG-5382, DIG-5383, DIG-5529.
- These are NOT stale-binding-404 (count=0 now) and NOT add_comment failures (count=0 now) — both prior classes are eliminated.
- The keys are PRESENT in the search snapshot (in-window) — no bound-but-absent / direct-GET signals — so outbound_differ._diff_fields is finding a genuine field difference that never converges.

## Hypothesis (needs per-field diagnosis)
A per-field re-emitter of the same family as the historically-fixed ones (85a1 ADF description, 4175 trailing-whitespace, 8b25 parent): a field the reconciler writes that Jira normalizes/rejects back, OR a field-shape/normalization mismatch in _extract_jira_field for these specific tickets, so local_val != extracted_jira_val every pass. update_one reports error=None (the write 'succeeds' or the field is mis-compared), so it loops.

## Repro / next step
outbound_differ emits no per-field 'changed' breadcrumb, so diagnosis needs either: (a) add a debug log of changed_fields per outbound update, or (b) manually compare local ticket vs live Jira (get_issue_by_rest) for DIG-5347 to find which field diverges. Low blast radius (~4 keys), non-fatal (pass exits 0).

comments.body: CLI_user: user-directed. Phase 1 = add changed-field breadcrumb to outbound diff (diagnosis enabler + permanent observability per sync-hardening P5) since no local Jira creds; identify the churning field via a live pass; then targeted normalization fix.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: DIAGNOSIS COMPLETE (live, branch runs). Convergence trajectory 16->11->4->...->3 mutations/pass. Findings: (1) The two big classes (stale-binding-404, comment-fail) are eliminated. (2) The 'in-window field re-emitters' were dominated by REAL pending edits from this session's heavy ticket churn (8 tickets created/closed + many comments) — they CONVERGED once pushed (e.g. DIG-4933 changed=[description] resolved after a pass pushed it). NOT a code bug. (3) Permanent changed-field/comment-label breadcrumb shipped (commits 3183391c88/fabce24e6e) — any future residual is now diagnosable by field name + comment/label counts. (4) GENUINE RESIDUAL: one persistent comment re-emitter (DIG-5383, changed=[] comments=1) — a comment-BODY ADF round-trip mismatch (same class as 85a1/4175 but for comment bodies): local body != adf_to_text(jira_comment_adf) because Jira re-renders the body server-side, so _diff_comments' membership test never matches and re-adds every pass. Deepest-layer fix requires a DESIGN DECISION (tolerant-compare vs synced-shadow vs precise value-capture-and-mirror) — raised to user.
